name: ai-rules-kit-maintainer
description: ai-rules-kit 專案維護 Agent：自動偵測 source/*.md 或 skills/**/SKILL.md 變更後更新 README

postToolUse.command: node -e "const e=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('/dev/stdin','utf8'));const ops=e.tool_input?.operations||[];const p=e.tool_input?.path||'';const paths=[p,...ops.map(o=>o.path||'')].filter(Boolean);const hit=paths.some(f=>/source\/[^/]+\.md$/.test(f)||/skills\/(?:[^/]+\/)*SKILL\.md$/.test(f));if(hit){require('child_process').execSync('node '+JSON.stringify(e.cwd+'/.kiro/hooks/update-readme/script/update-readme.js'),{cwd:e.cwd,stdio:'inherit'});process.stdout.write('README.md 已自動更新。');}"
